title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(蜂谷俊雄研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III (Hachiya Toshio)
keywords: Architectural design 2.Landscape design 3.Design trends 4.Design concept 5.Location and regional cooperation
educationalGoal: (1) Students will see and analyze world famous buildings and read books describing architectural design. In addition, they will consider what good architecture is. (2) Students can analyze the social situation and place surrounding a building, solve its complex conditions, and create a building form and space that satisfies the facility’s program and functionality. (3) Students can explain their efforts in excellent presentations and logically explain the design concept of the work.
advice: Course Description (1) Students will work on planning and design issues for site selection and facility program creation, as well as architectural design issues to be compiled as works. (2) Students will read designated architectural design books, summarize their points, and publish the summaries. (3) During the summer vacation, students will go on a tour to see a city and its architecture. They will investigate and analyze the city and its architecture and summarize the results in a report. (4) If there is a project related to the city or architecture, students will participate in a project activity. (5) Students will express the results of the year with drawings and models, present them in a public place, and receive a review. Expectations for students (1) Students should be interested in architectural design and regional planning, always striving to improve. (2) Students should admire beautiful architecture and their favorite spaces and consider the reasons. (3) Students should analyze works of famous architecture and analyze how they differ from the works they designed. (4) Students should keep thinking about what good architecture is and what design can last through history. (5) Students should actively apply for student architectural design competitions.
books: Textbooks:Not specified. Reference books:Not specified. Reserved books:Not specified.
requiredKnowledge: (1) It is desirable to have mastered "Architectural Integrated Exercises A and B" and further subjects such as "History of Japanese Architecture", " History of Occidental Architecture ", "Methods of Architectural Design", "Theory of Architectural Design". (2) Architectural design is the synthesis of various types of knowledge and technologies, and it is important to learn in a balanced way about other specialized fields such as history, cities, structures, production, and the environment.

activityGoals.body: Students can actively look at beautiful buildings, cities, and landscapes, and take notes and sketches.
Students can understand the excellent points of famous architecture, and compare it with their own works.
Students can comprehensively consider architectural design, and apply it to their own works.
Students can analyze various architectural issues, and present suggestions for improvement through their works.
Students can draw completed images of their work with computer graphics and explain it logically.
Students understand social trends in the field of architecture, and determine their own direction.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Students can analyze design theories and concepts that underlie excellent architectural design, evaluate them from various angles, including the background of the times, and apply them to their own work and develop them. (2) Students can analyze architectural issues in modern society and convert improvement plans into concrete facility programs. These can be completed as excellent architectural works. (3) Students can express their work attractively with drawings and models. In addition, the design concept of the work can be explained logically.

(2) Students can analyze architectural issues in modern society and convert improvement plans into concrete facility programs. These can be completed as architectural works. (3) Students can express their work with drawings and models and can explain the design concept of the work.
